accept_on_device_threshold.description: Used by the app. Key read in apps/web/src/firebase.ts (getNumber). Value matches packages/core/src/routing.ts DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.acceptOnDevice. At or above this grounded confidence, accept the on-device field; otherwise send it to the cloud. Not a clinically validated operating point.

human_review_threshold.description: Used by the app. Key read in apps/web/src/firebase.ts (getNumber). Value matches packages/core/src/routing.ts DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.humanReview. After a cloud check, confidence below this (or a device/cloud disagreement) goes to human confirm.

cloud_route_threshold.description: PROPOSED: not wired in the web app yet. Matches packages/parsing/src/extraction/route.ts DEFAULT_CLOUD_ROUTE_THRESHOLD (fields with confidence below this are nominated for cloud assist). The PRD also mentioned 0.70 as a possible demo default. Add a getNumber('cloud_route_threshold') call in the app before relying on this parameter.

cloud_model_name.description: PROPOSED: not read from Remote Config yet. The web app currently pins CLOUD_MODEL = 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite' in apps/web/src/firebase.ts (and packages/core/src/cost.ts). Wiring this key is recommended so the model can be changed without a release. Keep a stable model name during judging.
